offering_description.value: Mines and supplies frac sand, and provides logistics that move and store it, to oil and gas producers and well-completion service companies. It makes money by selling sand and charging for transport, transloading and storage at terminals near drilling areas.

primary_services.value: proppant logistics; transloading; last-mile delivery; storage at terminals

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production companies, pressure pumping service companies

revenue_model.value: product sales: frac sand sold to well operators and pumping companies; service fees: fees for sand transport, transloading and terminal storage

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: mined sand supplied to completion crews, sold to oil and gas operators and pumpers; service provider: logistics and terminal services moving sand to wellsites, sold to operators and pumpers

geography_served.value: US national: Permian, Haynesville, Appalachian and Mid-Continent oil and gas basins

specialization.value: related lines: frac sand supply and proppant logistics services that share oilfield customers and terminals

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sand contracts with exploration and production companies and pressure pumpers; own locations: company-operated mine and transload and storage terminals

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mining and environmental permits, workplace safety and transport rules from state agencies and federal mine safety regulators

notes: Exact mine and terminal locations and the regulatory details were not fully verified from memory.
